## How It Works

### Step 1: Chat With Us
<!-- @faq: how_to_start -->

Click **Get Started** on mybiz.fit. A chat widget opens — just tell us about your business. Your name, what you do, your services, your vibe. That's it. No forms to fill out. No software to learn. Just a conversation.

### Step 2: We Build It
<!-- @faq: what_we_build -->

Our team creates a custom landing page for your business. Your services, your photos, your contact info — all designed to turn visitors into customers. Most pages include:

- Hero section with your tagline and image
- Service showcase with icons and descriptions
- Photo gallery
- About section with your story
- Contact information and map
- Call-to-action banner
- Built-in chat widget

### Step 3: You're Live
<!-- @faq: how_to_share -->

Share your link: **mybiz.fit/your-business**. Put it on social media, business cards, ads — anywhere your customers are. Start capturing leads while you focus on what you do best.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Is it really free?
<!-- @faq: pricing -->

Yes. Your landing page with chat widget is free — forever. Pricing scales with your lead capture volume, so you only pay more as your business grows. No upfront costs. No contracts. No surprises.

---

### How long does setup take?
<!-- @faq: setup_time -->

Most businesses are live within 24 hours. Just chat with us, tell us about your business, and we'll handle the rest.

---

### Do I need technical skills?
<!-- @faq: technical_skills -->

Not at all. If you can type a message, you can use MyBiz.Fit. We build everything for you — no coding, no design skills needed.

---

### Can I customize my page?
<!-- @faq: customization -->

Absolutely. Your page is built around your business — your services, your brand, your story. Tell us what you need and we'll make it happen. You can choose from 41 themes, override accent colors, and add your own photos.

---

### What if I already have a website?
<!-- @faq: existing_website -->

No problem. Your MyBiz.Fit page works alongside your existing site. Many businesses use it as a focused landing page for specific campaigns or services.

---

### How do I get my page link?
<!-- @faq: page_link -->

After setup, you'll get a clean URL like **mybiz.fit/your-business**. Share it on social media, in ads, on business cards — anywhere your customers are.

---

### Can I update my page later?
<!-- @faq: updates -->

Yes. Just chat with us and tell us what changed — new services, new hours, new photos. We'll update it for you.

---

### Can I add photos?
<!-- @faq: photos -->

Yes! You can add photos to your gallery, hero section, about section, and product listings. Just upload them and we'll place them on your page.

---

### How does the chat widget work?
<!-- @faq: chat_widget -->

The chat widget sits in the bottom-right corner of your page. Visitors click it to open a conversation with you. Messages come through in real-time. You can customize the welcome message and it matches your brand colors.

---

### What themes are available?
<!-- @faq: themes -->

We have 41 theme presets in dark and light modes. Examples:

- **dark-amber** — warm golden tones (great for restaurants)
- **dark-teal** — professional blue-green (great for dental, real estate)
- **dark-forest** — earthy green (great for fitness, contractors)
- **dark-violet** — creative purple (great for salons, retail)
- **light-minimal** — clean white (great for medical, corporate)

You can also override the accent color with your brand's hex code.

## What We Don't Handle

### Full E-Commerce
<!-- @exclusion: ecommerce -->

We create landing pages with product showcases, but we don't handle shopping carts, payment processing, or inventory management. For full e-commerce, consider Shopify or WooCommerce.

### Custom Web Applications
<!-- @exclusion: custom_apps -->

We build landing pages, not web apps. If you need custom functionality like booking systems, member portals, or databases, you'll need a developer.

### SEO Management
<!-- @exclusion: seo -->

We create pages that are mobile-friendly and fast, but we don't provide ongoing SEO services. For SEO, consider a specialist.
